sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Red Lion supplies industrial networking, communication and data-acquisition hardware — the devices that connect field equipment, protocols and control systems and make plant data usable. We supply and integrate them as part of the automation and remote-monitoring scope.

items.title: Protocol gateways
items.text: Convert and bridge industrial protocols so legacy and modern equipment talk to one control system.

items.title: Industrial networking
items.text: Managed switches and cellular/edge devices for rugged plant and field networks.

items.title: HMIs & data acquisition
items.text: Panel HMIs, data loggers and controllers that capture and present field data.

sections.title: Typical applications
items: Protocol conversion between field devices and DCS/SCADA
Local operator interfaces on skids and packages

sections.title: Data is only useful if it moves
sections.text: The best instruments are wasted if their data can't reach the control room. Reliable, secure connectivity is what turns field signals into decisions.

sections.title: Let's discuss your next project
sections.text: Tell us what you are planning. An engineer will reply, not a sales queue.
